member.description: Identities that will be granted the privilege in `role`. Each entry can have one of the following values:
member.rationale: Controls which principals are granted access. Policy must block public principals (allUsers, allAuthenticatedUsers) and wildcard or over-broad grants; it must not dictate which specific users or groups a team may add.

note.description: Used to find the parent resource to bind the IAM policy to
note.rationale: Identifier referencing the target resource this binding applies to. Platform policy does not constrain resource names or references to other resources.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the project will be parsed from the identifier of the parent resource. If no project is provided in the parent identifier and no project is specified, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Identifier referencing the target resource this binding applies to. Platform policy does not constrain resource names or references to other resources.

role.description: The role that should be applied. Only one `google_container_analysis_note_iam_binding` can be used per role. Note that custom roles must be of the format `[projects|organizations]/{parent-name}/roles/{role-name}`.
role.rationale: Specifies the IAM role granted. Platform policy should not dictate which roles teams assign; access is constrained at the principal level (member/members) instead.
